result.brief: 提出 AM-RADIO 风格多教师蒸馏配方，通过拆分适配头、非对称损失、MIM 与 PHI-S 特征平衡，在保持全局识别的同时提升密集语义表征。
result.reason: Multi-teacher distillation into a ViT student improving dense semantics and global recognition; MIM and feature balancing are visual representation contributions, directly matching visual representation learning.
